description: This file contains the implementation of a cache controller used for managing HTTP request caching, e.g., handling cache validation, cache storage, cache lookup, and cache update logic within the context of HTTP request handling, specifically tailored for the 'requests' library in Python.

classes.name: CacheController
classes.description: A class responsible for controlling HTTP caching behavior, including cache lookup, validation, storage, and conditional request management.

methods.name: tuple[str,str,str,str,str] parse_uri(uri: str)
methods.description: Parses a URI into its components (scheme, authority, path, query, fragment) using a regex based on RFC 3986.

methods.name: CacheController.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the cache controller with optional cache, serializer, cache etags flag, and status codes.

methods.name: CacheController._urlnorm
methods.description: Normalizes a URI into a safe cache key, enforcing absolute URI format.

methods.name: CacheController.cache_url
methods.description: Provides a public method to normalize and obtain the cache key for a given URL.

methods.name: CacheController.parse_cache_control
methods.description: Parses the 'Cache-Control' header for directives like max-age, no-cache, etc.

methods.name: CacheController._load_from_cache
methods.description: Loads a cached HTTP response from the cache store if available.

methods.name: CacheController.cached_request
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a valid cached response for a given HTTP request; returns the cached response or False.

methods.name: CacheController.conditional_headers
methods.description: Generates conditional headers (If-None-Match, If-Modified-Since) based on cached response headers for revalidation requests.

methods.name: CacheController._cache_set
methods.description: Stores a response into the cache with associated request and optional expiration time.

methods.name: CacheController.cache_response
methods.description: Determines whether and how to cache a HTTP response, storing it in the cache if conditions are met.

methods.name: CacheController.update_cached_response
methods.description: Updates the cached response with headers from a 304 Not Modified response, replacing the existing cached content.
